item.title: Linejam v0.25.0
item.description:
New Features
- Improved visibility and readability across all themes with stronger color contrast.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't always join a game that was already in progress, even if there were open spots.

item.title: Linejam v0.24.1
item.description:
Bug Fixes
- Turning a poem's sharing on and off is now fully reliable — toggling it off actually revokes the link, and toggling it back on always produces a working link instead of a dead one. - Fixed a rare glitch where sharing a poem at the same time as another action (like a retry or a second share attempt) could leave the link in a broken or confusing state. - The poem page now correctly updates when a share link's status changes, so you won't see stale "expiring" messages after a link has already been renewed or revoked.

item.title: Linejam v0.24.0
item.description:
New Features
- Friends who show up late can now join instantly by scanning a QR code — no typing, no waiting for a fresh link. - If your connection drops mid-game, Linejam now reconnects you right back into the action without losing your spot. - The big reveal now unfolds poem by poem in a clear, accessible order, so everyone can follow along easily.
Bug Fixes
- Smoothed out rough edges in the mobile game experience, including keeping the join QR code fully visible on smaller screens.

item.title: Linejam v0.23.1
item.description:
Bug Fixes
- Cleaned up how poems store author information so lasting personal IDs no longer linger in poem data, tightening up privacy behind the scenes.

item.title: Linejam v0.23.0
item.description:
New Features
- Added behind-the-scenes safeguards for our AI-powered poem features, including an emergency shutoff and spending limits, so the game stays reliable even if something goes wrong with the AI service.
Improvements
- Tightened up how AI-generated content is managed, helping keep Linejam running smoothly for everyone during game night.

item.title: Linejam v0.22.0
item.description:
New Features
- Old game data doesn't pile up forever anymore — Linejam now automatically cleans up stale rooms, shares, and other leftovers after a set time, keeping things tidy behind the scenes.
Improvements
- Data cleanup runs on a predictable schedule, so there's less digital clutter without any action needed from players. - Behind-the-scenes safeguards ensure real player accounts are protected during cleanup, so you never have to worry about losing your own data.

item.title: Linejam v1.15.0
item.description:
Bug Fixes
- Fixed mobile writing to be fully playable with cleaner room interface.
New Features
- You can now play one streamlined core game mode (previous Rhyme and Quick modes have been combined). - You can now automatically become the host when the original host leaves the room. - The room now stays alive and recovers automatically if something goes wrong. - You can now see a shared recap of your game session after playing.

item.title: Linejam v1.13.0
item.description:

Bug Fixes

item.title: Linejam v1.12.0
item.description:
Breaking Changes
Game modes simplified: Linejam now focuses on one core collaborative poetry experience. The separate Rhyme Relay and Quick Jam modes have been removed to streamline gameplay. All rooms now use the same fun, pass-the-poem format you love.
New Features
- You can now vote for your favorite poem at the end of each game session. - You can now view a shared recap hub that shows all the poems created during your session. - The game now automatically keeps rooms alive and recovers from connection issues so your poetry sessions never get interrupted. - You can now seamlessly continue playing even if the original host leaves the room.
Improvements
- The mobile writing experience now works much better with improved touch controls and less screen clutter.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed mobile touch targets to work properly with thumbs on all game screens.

item.title: Linejam v1.11.0
item.description:
Breaking Changes
We've streamlined Linejam to focus on what works best! The separate Rhyme Relay and Quick Jam modes have been combined into one awesome core game mode. Your favorite features from both modes are still there—just in one place now.
New Features
- You can now keep playing even if your game host leaves, as we'll automatically pick a new host from your group. - You can now see a shared recap page after each game to relive your best poem moments together. - You can now vote for your favorite poem in each round, and we'll crown a room champion at the end.
Bug Fixes
- Fixed mobile writing to work smoothly on phones, making it much easier to add your lines on the go.

item.title: Linejam v1.10.0

Improvements
- The mobile writing experience is now much easier to use with a cleaner interface.

item.title: Linejam v0.1.0
item.description:
Get ready to unleash your inner poet! We're thrilled to announce the launch of Linejam, a brand new real-time collaborative poetry game where you and your friends can create beautiful verses together. Each game consists of 9 rounds, offering plenty of opportunities for creative expression and playful collaboration. If your muse is flying solo, don't fret! You can now play against AI opponents powered by Gemini, making Linejam a fun and engaging experience whether you're a lone wolf or part of a pack.
We've also added some delightful visual flair to enhance your playing experience. Choose from four premium themes – Kenya, Mono, Vintage Paper, and Hyper – to set the mood and inspire your creativity. And when you've crafted a poem you're proud of, easily share it with the world! A simple click lets you copy your masterpiece to the clipboard, ready to paste and share wherever your heart desires.
Need a little guidance? We've included a handy floating help modal that clearly explains the game's rules. Plus, our unique word count indicator, inspired by traditional Japanese genkoyoushi paper, helps you keep track of your progress and stay within the flow.
Finally, we've made some behind-the-scenes tweaks to ensure everything runs smoothly, including fixing an issue with word counting to handle those extra spaces. Happy jamming!
